title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Apply your brand kit and style to visual creations
description: Easily customize your visual content with built-in controls to select your preferred style, choose your visual format, whether it’s a poster, infographic, or image and with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, apply your brand kit.
